mapper.select: select notification_id as id, cip, type, contenu, lu, date_creation as dateCreation from app.Notification where cip = #{cip} order by date_creation desc
select count(*) from app.Notification where cip = #{cip} and lu = false
mapper.insert: insert into app.Notification(notification_id, cip, type, contenu, lu, date_creation) values (#{notification.id}, #{notification.cip}, #{notification.type}, #{notification.contenu}, #{notification.lu}, #{notification.dateCreation})
